header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Kanji Mal Meghwar, advocate for the petitioner
body: After arguing at some length, counsel for the petitioner submits that application available at Page-17 as Annexure-C be decided in accordance with law, and he would be satisfied if the directions will be issued to the Secretary, Sindh Local Government Board, Local Government Department, Government of Sindh, Karachi.

On such proposal, learned A.A.G conceded. Therefore, this petition is disposed of with directions to the Secretary, Sindh Local Government Board, Local Government Department, Government of Sindh, to decide the application available at Page-17 as Annexure-C, within 30 days.
